summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off the 2026/27 season and have been busy preparing with three brand new kits and some exciting new signings, plus a returning player to bolster the squad. The Ramblers suffered a narrow defeat to St Helens in their recent friendly, where St Helens' clinical finishing made the difference in a competitive match. With promotion the goal for the campaign ahead, the club is also looking for sponsorship partners and will be revealing more player details as the season gets underway.
